translated_title: Sheinbaum Calls on the Bank of Mexico to Review High Pensions of Its Former Officials

meta_description: Former governor Guillermo Ortiz and ex-president Ernesto Zedillo are among those collecting pensions of up to 400,000 pesos, above the President's own salary.
